method: hand-authored 2D axis/layer guide plus front master for appearance; no 3D made

arguments.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render, faithful orthographic mechanical component design. Image 1 is a spatial construction GUIDE deliberately authored for the SIDE view; preserve its front/back direction and depth relationships, not its crude polygon styling or exact proportions. Image 2 is the authoritative APPEARANCE MASTER of the same mecha; use its actual ivory shoulder cap, graphite/ivory bomber wing material, orange pivots, white/orange blunt cockpit chest, engine cylinder and core upper-arm construction. Draw ONLY the near RIGHT SHOULDER + bomber wing root/engine + adjacent chest + core upper arm down to elbow, as one coherent SINGLE PURE SIDE VIEW, facing LEFT. No whole robot, no collage and no second camera. The blunt central cockpit nose points LEFT. The cylindrical engine intake points LEFT in the SAME direction. The external engine is seen from its cylinder SIDE: show its long graphite cylinder side wall, ivory intake rim as a narrow side lip at the LEFT end, orange circumferential band, graphite nozzle at the RIGHT end. NEVER show the circular fan disk facing the viewer. The broad wingspan from Image 2 extends toward/away from this side camera, so in this view show only the thin chordwise aircraft-wing EDGE above the engine; NO broad triangular wing top surface is visible, NO large swept fin behind the head. Link that thin edge through the separate root bracket, as in Image 1; no floating wing. The inboard wing-root pivot is BEHIND the engine/wing carrier, separate from and ABOVE the actual round core shoulder joint. Keep a separate faceted IVORY UPPER-ARM SHOULDER CAP below the engine, enclosing the black shoulder joint; leave upper arm and elbow free beneath it. Engine/wing must NOT become the shoulder cap or the arm. The clean chest nose remains at LEFT, core arm at RIGHT/below it. There is no head in this component crop, no forearm fist, no train at the shoulder, no extra engine or wing. Preserve the source front master's detailed design grammar and exact colors; draw a professional KINETIC_CEL mecha animation model-sheet component with crisp pressure-varied ink and simple two-tone cel shadows on ivory. Strict camera perpendicular to the side plane, NO three-quarter perspective, NO top view, NO perspective fan disk, NO decorative circles replacing components. Everything fully in frame with margins. No text, arrows, labels or logos. Keep Image 1's orientation even if Image 2's attractive perspective would tempt you to copy it.
